PYTHONPATH=/app - BACKEND_URL=http://backend:8003 - ESPERTO_URL=http://esperto:5000 database: image: mariadb:latest container_name: database env_file: - .env ports: - "3306:3306" volumes: - ./mariadb_data:/var/lib/mysql healthcheck: test: ["CMD-SHELL", "mariadb -h 127.0.0.1 -u root -p\"$MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD\" -e 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null"] interval: 5s timeout: 5s retries: 10 start_period: 20s --- # FILE: backend/src/llm_judge/judge.py | SERVIZIO: backend # TIPO: FUNCTION | NOME: ask_ollama --- IMPORTS DI CONTESTO --- from __future__ import annotations import json import re from typing import Any, AsyncIterator from urllib.error import HTTPError, URLError from urllib.request import Request, urlopen from config import THINK from ..database.db_manipolation import DatabaseManipulator from ..log import get_logger --- CODICE SORGENTE --- def ask_ollama(prompt: str, model: str, think: bool = THINK) -> str: """ Invia un prompt a Ollama e restituisce la risposta testuale del modello. Args: prompt: Testo da inviare al modello. model: Nome del modello Ollama da usare. think: Se True, il modello pensa prima di rispondere. Returns: Risposta testuale prodotta dal modello. Raises: ValueError: Se il prompt e vuoto o la risposta non e valida. RuntimeError: Se la chiamata HTTP a Ollama fallisce. """ if not prompt.strip(): raise ValueError("prompt cannot be empty") base_url = OLLAMA_BASE_URL url = f"{base_url.rstrip('/')}/api/chat" payload = { "model": model, "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}], "stream": False, "think": think, } request = Request( url, data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"), headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}, method="POST", ) try: with urlopen(request, timeout=600) as response: data = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8")) except HTTPError as error: raise RuntimeError(f"Ollama HTTP error: {error.code} {error.reason}") from error except URLError as error: raise RuntimeError(f"Ollama connection error: {error.reason}") from error except json.JSONDecodeError as error: raise RuntimeError("Invalid JSON response from Ollama") from error message = data.get("message", {}) content = message.get("content", "") if not isinstance(content, str) or not content.strip(): raise RuntimeError("Empty response from Ollama") return content.strip() --- #
